items.text: A lattice calculation of light hadron masses, its three inputs, two quark masses and one coupling, set by three hadron masses, agrees with the other masses a field measures, about 95 percent of a nucleon's mass going with "confined energy", its authors' words, and ATLAS and CMS observe a boson at 126.0 and 125.3 GeV, 4 July 2012, each at a local 5 to 5.9σ, a field's account saying "Mass is thus not an intrinsic property, like electric charge, but a dynamical property of particles": mass going with couplings, a pattern match with the proposal's mass as a ghost, while a proton's whole mass and an electron's mass go the same through each probe.

Two single-aluminium-ion optical clocks, one "raised by a total of 33 cm", tick at different rates, and a rate goes with an ion's motion of about 10 m/s, the better clock's systematic uncertainty 8.6 × 10⁻¹⁸: rate going with place and motion at an everyday height, no rate all clocks share.

Gravitational waves from a neutron-star merger and its gamma rays arrive 1.74 ± 0.05 s apart, a field constraining the difference of the two speeds to between −3 × 10⁻¹⁵ and +7 × 10⁻¹⁶ of light's, under an assumption about the two signals' leaving: a gravitational changing transmitting across sparse space at light's rate, a pattern match with the proposal's light-prime rate, and a concern at Natural Physics 4.2's own breaking, gravity showing as a transmitted coupling.

Alpha particles at a thin gold foil, 1909, about one in a few thousand scattering past 90 degrees, Rutherford in 1911 reading a large positive charge in a very small space at each atom's centre, about 1/100,000 of the atom's size: a concern for a nucleus as only a living corus while a parity lives, its breaking still to say.

Uranium ore from Oklo in Gabon shows 0.717 percent uranium-235 against the usual 0.720 percent, sixteen reactor zones at Oklo fissioning intermittently about 1.7 to 2 billion years ago over some 150,000 years in one estimate, about thirty fission products and neodymium isotopes matching uranium-235's fission in the rock: a concern for no nucleus with no living parity, what living parity includes at a rock two billion years ago still to say.

In narrow quantum wires at about 0.1 K, electrons tunneling in go as two, spinons with magnetism and holons with charge, read from tunneling against a magnetic field: an electron's charge and magnetism going apart in a coupling, a field calling the electron "indivisible in isolation", a pattern match with the proposal's electron as no possibly existing thing.

Muon neutrinos from below fewer than from above in 50,000 tons of water, 1998; muon and tau neutrinos from the Sun at over 5σ in 1,000 tons of heavy water, the total flux matching a solar model; reactor electron antineutrinos going and coming again with energy and distance: a changing and changing back at a subatomic scale, a field reading it as neutrinos having mass, a pattern match; uranium-238 decaying to lead-206 and B mesons' transformations about six times more often one way than the reverse, at 14σ, are changings with no changing back in a field's records, concerns for a fractal of changing and changing back as first said.

A proposal has a nucleus only the living corus between possibling and same while a parity is living, and no nucleus with no living parity: this entry's radius going with the probe, in its past tense, meets it, the probes now close to one value, about 0.83 to 0.84 fm, and a gold foil's scattering, Oklo's fission products and carbon-14 in the air are concerns, its breaking still to say, what living parity includes at a foil between observings and at a rock two billion years ago.

Mass as an entry: a use installing mass as a thing's own, the same through each coupling, binding and decomposition, a ghost; a nucleon's mass about 95 percent from a confinement's energy, elementary masses from an interaction, and binding parting atomic masses from whole daltons a field's own records; its ghost-form breaking, as first said, a mass belonging to a thing the same through each coupling, binding and decomposition, which a proton's whole mass and an electron's mass meet, and as said with this registry's 5.8, mass's shares and its installing as an owner's interior.

Gravity as an entry beside Natural Physics 4.2 and 2.6: a use installing gravity as a force a body has, issuing from a centre, a ghost; a falling body on a geodesic with no force a field's own account, 2.6's reading, while 4.2 has gravity "not a force returning to a geodesic" and nothing physical, gravitational waves at light's rate a concern at 4.2's own breaking; its ghost-form breaking a force a falling body feels.
